nodes.name: auth.js
nodes.summary: Shared authentication library exporting authUtils and authMiddleware: JWT signing/verification, bcrypt password handling, Redis-cached permission checks, scope-based Prisma filter, and Express middleware (authenticate, requireRole, requirePermission, etc.).

nodes.name: authUtils.hashPassword
nodes.summary: Bcrypt-hash a password with cost 12.

nodes.name: authUtils.comparePassword
nodes.summary: bcrypt.compare wrapper.

nodes.name: authUtils.generateToken
nodes.summary: Sign JWT with JWT_SECRET and configurable expiry.

nodes.name: authUtils.verifyToken
nodes.summary: Verify a JWT against JWT_SECRET.

nodes.name: authUtils.checkPermission
nodes.summary: Redis-cached permission check using effective permissions and matchesPermission.

nodes.name: authUtils.getEffectivePermissions
nodes.summary: Fetch effective permissions from auth-service via HTTP, cache in Redis (5min), fallback to JWT-embedded permissions.

nodes.name: authUtils.invalidatePermissionCache
nodes.summary: Clears perms:{userId} and perm:{userId}:* keys in Redis.

nodes.name: authUtils.applyScopeFilter
nodes.summary: Adds role-aware Prisma where conditions: superadmin/admin pass-through, outlet=own, client=clientId OR, sub-users by accessLevel, affiliate=assignedIds.

nodes.name: authMiddleware.authenticate
nodes.summary: Express middleware that verifies Bearer JWT, checks Redis blacklist and session, normalizes req.user.

nodes.name: authMiddleware.requireRole
nodes.summary: Middleware enforcing one of given roles; admin/superadmin bypass.

nodes.name: authMiddleware.requirePermission
nodes.summary: Middleware delegating to authUtils.checkPermission and logging denials.

nodes.name: Secure Docker Builder README
nodes.summary: Documents the zero-source-code Docker image builder: binary compilation via pkg, JavaScript obfuscation, hardware-bound license activation, heartbeat monitoring, registry integration, and CLI usage (generate-config, build, push, run) for distributing the logistics platform to clients.

nodes.name: Secure Build Config
nodes.summary: Concrete build configuration for client Sayan Choudhury: clientId, list of services (auth, user, api-gateway, shipment, partner, wallet, support, platform), TRIAL license, Docker registry sayansr26/logistics-secure-client, license server localhost:3011, secret key, tag and output image name.

nodes.name: Secure Docker Builder package.json
nodes.summary: NPM manifest for @logistics/secure-docker-builder v2.0.0; bin logistics-secure-build maps to src/cli.js; dependencies include commander, inquirer, dockerode, javascript-obfuscator, ora, chalk; pkg target builds linux x64/arm64/alpine binaries.

nodes.name: showBanner
nodes.summary: Clears the terminal and prints a cyan ASCII banner for the Logistics Secure Docker Builder.

nodes.name: getInteractiveConfig
nodes.summary: Prompts the operator (via inquirer) for clientId UUID, client name, license type, Docker registry, license server URL and monitoring flag; hardcodes the full list of production services (frontend, api-gateway, auth, user, shipment, partner, wallet, support, platform) excluding license-service, generates a hex secretKey and time-stamped tag, and returns the merged build config object.

nodes.name: buildSecureImage
nodes.summary: Top-level build orchestrator: instantiates SecureImageBuilder, runs the build, optionally pushes to registry, cleans the build directory, prints client-facing docker pull/run commands and writes a {clientId}-image.json reference file.

nodes.name: pushToRegistry
nodes.summary: Computes the full registry image name from the configured registry path and tag, tries docker buildx multi-platform (linux/amd64+linux/arm64) build-and-push from Dockerfile.deployment, and falls back to single-platform docker tag/push if buildx is unavailable.

nodes.name: generateInstructions
nodes.summary: Writes a {clientId}-instructions.md file containing client deployment steps: docker pull/run commands with required volumes and port range 3000-3011, management commands (logs/stop/restart/remove) and troubleshooting tips for license, port and Docker issues.

nodes.name: SecureImageBuilder
nodes.summary: Class encapsulating the secure image build pipeline: prepares .build-temp, compiles obfuscated activator.js, builds individual service images (backend or frontend), and creates a final docker:24-dind deployment image embedding the activator and exposing ports 3000-3011.

nodes.name: SecureImageBuilder.build
nodes.summary: Main entry method that drives the five build steps with an ora spinner: prepareBuildDirectory, compileActivationBinary, createOrchestratorImage, buildServiceImages, createDeploymentImage; returns image name, registry, size and buildDir for downstream multi-platform push.

nodes.name: compileActivationBinary
nodes.summary: Reads runtime-activator.js, substitutes BUILD_LICENSE_SERVER, BUILD_SECRET_KEY and BUILD_REGISTRY placeholders, then runs javascript-obfuscator with aggressive settings (control flow flattening, dead code, debug protection, base64+rc4 string array, self-defending) and writes the obfuscated activator.js into the build directory.

nodes.name: buildServiceImages
nodes.summary: Iterates over the configured services list and delegates to buildServiceImage for each one.

nodes.name: buildServiceImage
nodes.summary: Writes a multi-stage Dockerfile for a backend service that installs production deps with pnpm, strips test/spec/docs/source-map files, minifies JS via terser, embeds a check-license.sh that requires LICENSE_KEY env, runs as non-root nodejs user with a healthcheck and EXPOSE on the service's port from getServicePort; routes frontend builds to buildFrontendImage.

nodes.name: buildFrontendImage
nodes.summary: Generates a Dockerfile that runs pnpm install + pnpm build for the Next.js frontend in a builder stage, copies .next/public/next.config.mjs into a slim runtime image with a license-check script, exposes port 3000 and runs pnpm start as the nodejs user.

nodes.name: createDeploymentImage
nodes.summary: Writes Dockerfile.deployment based on docker:24-dind with nodejs, docker-compose and curl installed; copies activator.js to /usr/local/bin and emits a logistics-deploy bash wrapper that starts dockerd if needed and then executes node /usr/local/bin/activator.js; exposes ports 3000-3011 and defines persistent volumes /var/lib/docker and /opt/logistics.

nodes.name: getServicePort
nodes.summary: Maps service names to their canonical ports: api-gateway 3001, auth 3002, user 3003, shipment 3004, partner 3005, wallet 3006, support 3007, platform 3008; defaults to 3000.

nodes.name: getImageSize
nodes.summary: Queries Docker for the built image's size via docker images --format and returns the trimmed string, or 'Unknown' on failure.

nodes.name: runtime activator main
nodes.summary: Obfuscation-target entrypoint shipped inside the deployment image; orchestrates the on-client activation flow: shows banner, prompts for license key and admin password, computes a machine fingerprint, calls the license server, pulls service images, generates configuration and docker-compose, starts services and a periodic heartbeat.

nodes.name: getMachineFingerprint
nodes.summary: Builds a hardware fingerprint from OS hostname, platform, arch, CPU info and network interfaces, hashed via crypto, used to hardware-bind the issued license.

nodes.name: validateLicense
nodes.summary: Sends license key and machine fingerprint to the configured LICENSE_SERVER /api/v1/activate endpoint over HTTPS and returns the activation payload that authorises which services and tier the client may run.

nodes.name: pullDockerImages
nodes.summary: Iterates over services granted by the activation response and runs docker pull from the configured DOCKER_REGISTRY so the deployment image can launch them locally.

nodes.name: generateDockerCompose
nodes.summary: Writes a docker-compose.yml at runtime, wiring each licensed service with its port from getServicePort, env vars including LICENSE_KEY and generated DB/Redis connection strings, shared volumes and the logistics network.

nodes.name: startServices
nodes.summary: Invokes docker-compose up -d using the generated compose file to bring up all activated logistics services inside the dind deployment container.

nodes.name: startHeartbeat
nodes.summary: Schedules periodic POSTs to the license server's /api/v1/heartbeat path with the activation id and machine fingerprint so the license server can revoke or renew long-running deployments.

nodes.name: Wallet API HMAC Integration Doc
nodes.summary: Documents the external wallet API (wapi.websiteduniya.com/api/v1): defines Postman environment variables, a pre-request script that computes an HMAC-SHA256 signature over METHOD:path:timestamp[:bodyHash] using a shared secret, and the required headers X-Wallet-Signature, X-Timestamp, X-Request-ID, X-User-ID and Bearer Authorization.
